heroHeadline: California Grid Batteries Discharge 12,000 MW — World's First Semi-Solid State E-Bike Launched
heroSubtitle: California's 17,000 MW battery storage fleet delivered 12,000 MW during peak evening hours on May 5 — meeting 40%+ of state electricity demand and validating grid-scale BESS as primary infrastructure. Simultaneously, Ride1Up launched the world's first commercial e-bike with a semi-solid state battery, and CATL's CAIT division signed its first overseas passenger EV platform deal with Turkish automaker Togg.
footerNote: Data sourced from official company reports, IEA, BloombergNEF, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, SNE Research, and peer-reviewed publications. Lab results distinguished from commercial production figures throughout.
